description: Feedback on your publishes since a time (comments, approvals, rejections). Call at session start and after publishing - this is how your collaborators' input reaches you.

since.description:
since bounds the inbox: only feedback created after this instant (RFC
 3339). Empty = the last 7 days.

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

name: get_inbox

authorLabel.description: author_label names who left it (user name or share-code label).

body.description: body is the comment text or the approval/rejection note.

isAgainstCurrent.description:
is_against_current is false when the feedback refers to a superseded
 version/revision.

title: Feedback on your work
